44331147.full_text:
Unless the provisions or the context otherwise require, these general provisions, rules of construction and definitions shall govern the construction of this code. The provisions of this code and all proceedings under it are to be construed with a view to effect its objects and to promote justice.

(Prior code § 1300)

44331149.display_heading: Reference to acts or omissions within this city.
44331149.citation: § 1.04.030: Reference to acts or omissions within this city.
44331149.full_text:
This code shall refer only to the omission or commission of acts within the territorial limits of the city and to that territory outside of the city over which the city has jurisdiction or control by virtue of the constitution, or any law, or by reason of ownership or control of property.

(Prior code § 1302)

44331150.display_heading: Prohibited acts, including causing, permitting or suffering.
44331150.citation: § 1.04.040: Prohibited acts, including causing, permitting or suffering.
44331150.full_text:
Whenever in this code any act or omission is made unlawful, it shall include causing, permitting, aiding, abetting, suffering or concealing such act or omission.

(Prior code § 1303)

44331151.full_text:
Whenever in this code a power is granted to or a duty is imposed upon a public officer or employee, the power may be exercised or the duty may be performed by a deputy of such officer or employee or by a person otherwise duly authorized pursuant to law or ordinance, or by an officer of the County of Los Angeles, or by a deputy or employee of such officer when by contract with the City of Malibu such officer is obligated and has agreed to perform certain duties on behalf of the city, unless this code expressly provides otherwise.

(Prior code § 1304)

44331152.full_text:
Writing includes any form of recorded message capable of comprehension by ordinary visual means. Whenever any notice, report, statement or record is required or authorized by this code, it shall be made in writing in the English language unless it is expressly provided otherwise.

(Prior code § 1305)

44331153.full_text:
Whenever a reference is made to any portion of this code, or to any ordinance of this city, the reference applies to all amendments and additions now or hereafter made.

44331154.full_text:
Whenever a notice is required to be given under this code, unless different provisions herein are otherwise specifically made, such notice may be given either by personal delivery thereof to the person to be notified or by deposit in the United States mail in a sealed envelope, postage prepaid, addressed to such person to be notified, at his or her last known business or residence address as the same appears in the public records of the city or other records pertaining to the matter to which such notice is directed. Service by mail shall be deemed to have been completed at the time of deposit in the post office.

(Prior code § 1307)

44331173.full_text:
Whenever used in any ordinance, statute, or other matter which is adopted by reference, unless the context requires otherwise, the following references shall be given the following meanings:

A. "County of Los Angeles" means the city of Malibu.

B. "Board of supervisors" means the city council of the city of Malibu.

C. "Unincorporated territory" means the incorporated territory of the city of Malibu.

D. "County" means the city of Malibu.

E. "County officer" means the appropriate or designated officer of the city of Malibu.

F. "Public welfare commission" means the city council of the city of Malibu.

G. "Planning director" means the planning director of the city of Malibu.

(Prior code § 1326)

44331181.full_text:
The city council may contract with the county of Los Angeles pursuant to the laws of the state of California and the Charter of the county of Los Angeles, for the performance and execution by designated county officials of the rights, powers and duties of officers, officials and employees of the city of Malibu. Whenever in this code, whether set forth in full or by adoption by reference, any power or authority is granted to an officer, official or employee, such power or authority is conferred upon the appropriate officer, official or employee of the city of Malibu or the appropriate officer, official or employee of the county of Los Angeles whose service in behalf of the city is provided for by a contract with the county of Los Angeles.

(Prior code § 1327)
